# Agent-Safe Bible

Public-domain Scripture corpus and agent contract.
https://github.com/ChristFollower873461/agent-safe-bible

Read AGENTS.md first. Default translation: BSB. Allowed: BSB, WEB, KJV. Refused: NIV, ESV, NASB, NLT, CSB, NKJV, and any other limited-license edition.

Quote only via local lookup:

    python3 -m asb get "John 3:16" --tr BSB

Never quote from memory. Never paraphrase as Scripture. Fail closed on unknown references and refused translations. Do not call remote Bible APIs.

MCP: python3 -m asb mcp
Tools: get_passage, list_translations

v0 status: 66-book hashed corpora for BSB, WEB, and KJV are present. Runtime is offline.

Key files:
- AGENTS.md
- skills/scripture-quote/SKILL.md
- data/allowlist.json
- data/corpus/
- schemas/passage.v1.schema.json
